answer: In the AI agent economy, a "Violet" jury of randomly selected peers evaluates identities. Each identity must deposit a "Plume" fee, which is locked until legitimacy is proven. An attacker with multiple fake identities incurs a linear cost of Plume per identity, while a single honest agent pays once. "Trellis" monitors detect inconsistencies, triggering honeypot challenges to reveal colluding identities.
